meta.description: Reusable Quant V4 solving strategies. Chapters own math; this library owns teachable strategy language.

strategies.title: Convert percentage to multiplier
strategies.description: Teach percent increase/decrease as multiplication by 1 plus or minus the rate.

strategies.title: Convert common percentages to fractions
strategies.description: Use memorized percent-fraction equivalents before formula work.

strategies.title: Work from 100%
strategies.description: Anchor unknown original or changed values around 100% before calculating.

strategies.title: Assume a common multiple
strategies.description: Represent ratio terms as parts of a shared multiple to avoid premature unit conversion.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: There are 8 parts, so one part is 10

strategies.title: Divide in proportional parts
strategies.description: Use total parts to split a known total according to a ratio.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: Total parts are 9, so one part is ₹100

strategies.title: Average as total divided by count
strategies.description: Convert average questions into total-sum reasoning before adjusting values.

strategies.title: Use cost price as base
strategies.description: Treat profit/loss percentages as changes on cost price, not selling price unless stated.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: Selling price is 125% of cost price

strategies.title: Total work equals LCM
strategies.description: Choose total work as the LCM of individual times to get integer efficiencies.

reusableExamples.prompt: A finishes in 6 days and B in 8 days
reusableExamples.teachingMove: Take total work as LCM(6,8)=24 units

strategies.title: Worker efficiencies
strategies.description: Convert days taken into work done per day, then combine efficiencies.

reusableExamples.prompt: A does 1/5 work daily and B does 1/10

strategies.title: Interest is proportional to time and rate
strategies.description: For simple interest, scale interest linearly with principal, rate, and time.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: 10% of principal each year for 3 years

strategies.title: Compound through multipliers
strategies.description: Use repeated multipliers instead of repeatedly adding interest manually.

strategies.title: Keep speed, time, and distance triangle explicit
strategies.description: Choose the missing quantity from distance = speed × time before substitution.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: Distance equals speed multiplied by time

strategies.title: Use weighted average view
strategies.description: Treat mixture concentration as a weighted average of component concentrations.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: Target concentration must lie between both concentrations

strategies.title: Delay variables until structure is clear
strategies.description: Explain the relationship in words before assigning variables for future algebraic topics.

reusableExamples.teachingMove: First state: original plus 5 gives 17, then write x + 5 = 17

strategies.title: Read labels before calculating
strategies.description: Identify units, category labels, and totals before applying arithmetic.

reusableExamples.prompt: A table shows sales in thousands
reusableExamples.teachingMove: Convert the label before calculating actual sales
